name: dsh-llm-opencode-go-live
description: DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenCode Go 动态模型目录插件。它从 Models.dev 更新 `opencode-go` 模型列表，注册独立的 `opencode-go-live` 路由。An OpenCode Go live model catalog plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It reads the `opencode-go` catalog from Models.dev, registers the separate `opencode-go-live` route.
